verdict.rationale: Datadog has a first-party "Datadog MCP Server" docs page, and a probe independently confirms an official MCP server is documented at docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/. A markdown version of that page is also provided for AI agents. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools, auth/connection setup and supported agent clients, plus independent hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
